title: Use of Photos and Renderings | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Interior photos, 3D renderings and drawings on the DUMSKAYA DESIGN website are protected by copyright: what is allowed and how to get a licence.

parts.html: Interior photos, 3D renderings, drawings and other images on dumskaya-design.com were created by the DUMSKAYA DESIGN interior design studio or commissioned by it and are protected by copyright. © DUMSKAYA DESIGN.

blocks.text: What you may do without permission

parts.html: Share a link to a page of the website — on social media, in messengers and e-mails. A link preview may show an image from that page.

blocks.text: What you may not do without permission

parts.html: Copy or publish the images on other websites, social media, marketplaces or in advertising; present the studio’s projects as your own; alter the images or remove the credit or author information.

Write to us at dumskaya.design@gmail.com or use the form on the Contact page: which images (a link to the page), where and for what purpose you would like to use them. We reply within one working day and send you the terms.
When use is permitted, credit the author: “© DUMSKAYA DESIGN, dumskaya-design.com”.
